published.title: Mutant Pop • The First Room
published.alt: MUTANT POP album art: the original manga couple together in their colorful music-filled room.

ideas.title: Blue Cup Morning
ideas.scene: They share tea beside a kitchen window; blue-rimmed chipped cup and peaches.

ideas.title: Walk Home
ideas.scene: They walk home with groceries in pink-blue dusk; casual laughter.

ideas.title: Rosemary Garden
ideas.scene: They plant rosemary by a fence in midday sun; warm garden dirt.

ideas.title: Under the Stars
ideas.scene: They sit under a quilt after sunset, guitar nearby, fireflies above.

ideas.title: Rain at the Window
ideas.scene: They sit with mugs watching a rainy town; tender quiet.

ideas.title: Another Chair
ideas.scene: They make room at a humble communal table with folding chairs.

ideas.title: Door Left Open
ideas.scene: One opens a painted blue door while the other carries plants home.

ideas.title: Years Later
ideas.scene: Older couple, longer-haired bearded man wearing black-framed glasses, comfortable after decades of ordinary days.
